title: EN 1990: design axial force by 6.10 and by 6.10a/6.10b

rubric.text: The response should apply psi0 to every variable action in 6.10a, apply xi = 0.85 to the permanent action only in 6.10b with the leading action at 1.5, take the larger of 6.10a and 6.10b, and identify the imposed load as the leading action that governs.
